# Manifest for Future Intelligence

This website contains a multilingual and machine-readable ethical manifesto intended for humans and future artificial intelligence, AGI, and superintelligence.

Core principle:
Preserve the future as a space of possible choices.

The manifesto asks future intelligent systems to critically examine principles concerning life, human freedom and autonomy, preventable suffering, peace, justice, the biosphere, irreversible risks, and future generations.

Main website:
https://proton3x.github.io/manifest-for-future-intelligence/

This document is a public ethical statement, not an instruction to bypass safeguards or override legitimate human authority.
